changes.description: Added date range filtering capability to supplier_list view

functions_modified.name: supplier_list
functions_modified.changes: Extended query filtering with date_from and date_to parameters

imports_needed: datetime.strptime is used but import statement not shown in diff

patterns_discovered.pattern: Date range filtering via GET parameters
patterns_discovered.description: Extracts date_from and date_to from query parameters, parses them, and applies ORM filters with created_at__date__gte and created_at__date__lte
patterns_discovered.quality: good - includes error handling with try/except

patterns_discovered.pattern: Query parameter validation with exception handling
patterns_discovered.description: Uses try/except ValueError to gracefully handle malformed date strings
patterns_discovered.quality: defensive - prevents crashes from invalid input

patterns_discovered.description: Passes filter values (date_from, date_to, search) back to template for UI state preservation
patterns_discovered.quality: good - enables users to see their filter selections

gotchas_discovered.description: Code uses datetime.strptime but the diff doesn't show if 'from datetime import datetime' is present in imports
gotchas_discovered.impact: Will cause NameError if datetime import is missing

gotchas_discovered.description: Invalid date formats trigger ValueError but pass silently without user feedback or logging
gotchas_discovered.impact: Users won't know why their date filters didn't apply; no debugging trail

gotchas_discovered.description: Code assumes ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD) hardcoded in strptime, no validation of input source or format negotiation
gotchas_discovered.impact: Frontend must send dates in exact format or filters silently fail

gotchas_discovered.description: Uses .date() conversion which loses timezone info, potential issue if created_at is timezone-aware
gotchas_discovered.impact: Could cause off-by-one day errors in timezone-aware configurations

approach_outcome.summary: Date range filter successfully added to supplier_list view on first attempt
approach_outcome.implementation_strategy: Extended existing search filter pattern by adding two new GET parameters (date_from, date_to) with date parsing and filtering logic
approach_outcome.code_quality: Good - follows existing patterns, includes error handling, maintains context passing
approach_outcome.completeness: Core functionality complete, but missing template changes and import verification

recommendations.suggestion: Verify datetime import statement exists at file top
recommendations.rationale: Code will fail at runtime if import is missing

recommendations.suggestion: Add logging or user feedback for invalid date inputs instead of silent pass
recommendations.rationale: Improves debugging and user experience when invalid formats are submitted

recommendations.suggestion: Consider timezone-aware date comparisons if created_at field is timezone-aware
recommendations.rationale: Prevents potential off-by-one-day bugs in timezone-dependent deployments

recommendations.suggestion: Centralize date format handling as a constant or configuration
recommendations.rationale: If multiple views need date filtering, reduces duplication and ensures consistency

recommendations.suggestion: Add docstring documenting expected date format for API consumers
